# Rokid Lumen

> Rokid Lumen is an Android app platform for Rokid RG glasses (Android 12, a 480x640
> monochrome green additive HUD), controlled with the Meta Neural Band. The glasses app
> (dev.lumen.glasses) runs Meta Ray-Ban Display style web apps (offline .mrbd.zip packages and
> online HTTPS apps) in GeckoView 156 or the system WebView (Chromium 95), shows the phone's
> notifications and offers dictation. The phone companion (dev.lumen.companion) forwards
> notifications, transcribes the glasses' microphone, arranges the apps grid and shares the
> phone's internet through a local-only hotspot and proxy. MIT, by Levi Nóbrega.

Web apps get a 600x600 CSS pixel viewport, arrow keys and Enter from the band, and Escape for
Back. The host adds `window.lumen.config` (settings declared in the manifest's `lumen_config`
and set from the phone), `navigator.install`, and fills in `navigation.canGoBack` and
`speechSynthesis` where the engine lacks them.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): what Lumen is, features, install, recommended use, build
- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): requirements, installing both apps, Hi Rokid
  authorization, the band's key and pairing, the self-arm and how to undo it
- [Features](docs/features.md): band gestures and mappings, the apps grid, notifications,
  internet through the phone, dictation engines, the companion's tabs
- [Building apps](docs/building-apps.md): the developer guide for Lumen web apps: input model,
  Back, the composer, the host APIs, the manifest fields, packaging and installing, engines,
  testing on the glasses
- [Security](docs/security.md): the security model and the known open issues

## Agents

- [Lumen app skill](skills/lumen-app/SKILL.md): a checklist, a manifest template and the
  pitfalls, for coding agents that build Lumen apps
